chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from al-ʿUmarkī, from ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar, from his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about reed mats that urine falls upon: is salat (prayer) valid upon them when they have dried without being washed? He said: Yes, there is no problem.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: salat (prayer), whose validity is being asked about
key_terms.الْبَوَارِيِّ: reed mats or woven floor mats
key_terms.الْبَوْلُ: urine, the impurity discussed in the ruling
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray on a reed mat that was touched by urine after it has dried?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about performing salat (prayer) on reed mats affected by urine after they have dried. It indicates permissibility in this case, making it relevant to rulings of ritual purity and the validity of prayer.
